newsitem.title: UK: LME nickel slumps to fresh low, others mostly firm.
newsitem.headline: LME nickel slumps to fresh low, others mostly firm.

text.p: Nickel prices slumped to fresh 2-1/4 year lows by the close of the morning session on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Tuesday after another wave of speculative selling pushed the market to a bearish close.
Most other metals made ground by the end of a shortened trading day. The exchange is closed on Tuesday afternoon, Wednesday and Thursday for public Christmas holidays.
Three month nickel futures finished the morning session at $6,480 a tonne, down $35 from Monday's afternoon kerb finish.
The market did peak at $6,580 shortly before the end of the session before being hit again.
